title: Peachy
author: Vythic
rules:
Play on SudokuPad!

Normal sudoku rules apply.

Three cells connected by a peach line consist of one low digit (1, 2, 3), one medium digit (4, 5, 6), and one high digit (7, 8, 9).

A pink line contains a consecutive set of digits in any order, without repeats.

Digits in a cage cannot repeat and sum to the number in the top-left of the cage.

Digits separated by a black dot have a 1:2 ratio.
